tools.description:
Search Google Patents for patents and published applications worldwide.

Returns publication numbers, assignees, first inventors, priority,
filing, publication, and grant dates, a snippet, and Google Patents / PDF
links. Google Patents matches keywords loosely, so quote technical
phrases and combine them with AND/OR and parentheses, e.g.
`("key encapsulation" OR KEM) AND (masking OR "side-channel")`.
`assignee:Name` restricts results to one assignee. Each page holds up to
ten results (`num` trims the page); `page` continues. Use web_fetch on a
result's Google Patents link to read the claims and full description.
Each call is billed by Serper; identical calls within an hour are cached.
tools.name: patent-search-mcp_patent_search
